Name: Industrialization for Utility Grid Redux
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
This is made explicitly as an addon for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47689]Utility Grid Redux[/url]. If you are not going to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47689]Utility Grid Redux[/url] and want the non powered version use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22351]Industrialization Redux[/url] instead.

[b][size=4]Industrialization for Utility Grid Redux[/size][/b]

[size=3]This mod combines and updates the following mods to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/mods/47689]Utility Grid Redux[/url]:[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5102]Official - Industrialization for PFM (Deprecated)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12156]Industrialization Official Utility Grid Addon [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11331]Industrialization Settings For Utility Grid [/url]

[size=4][b]Materials[/b][/size]
[spoiler]These are the new materials added by the mod. They do not directly use water or power.

[b]Brick[/b] is used for crafting industrial machines.
[b]Chromium Bar[/b] is a strong industrial alloy used for higher-tier machines.
[b]Chromium Compound[/b] is made from prismatic, iridium, and quartz powders.
[b]Pulverized Copper[/b] is crushed copper used in furnace processing.
[b]Pulverized Iron[/b] is crushed iron used in furnace processing.
[b]Pulverized Gold[/b] is crushed gold used in furnace processing.
[b]Pulverized Iridium[/b] is crushed iridium used in furnace processing.
[b]Pulverized Quartz[/b] is crushed quartz used in furnace processing.
[b]Pulverized Radioactive Metal[/b] is crushed radioactive material used in furnace processing.
[b]Pulverized Prismatic Shard[/b] is crushed prismatic material used in advanced processing.
[b]Smelted Fairy Stone[/b] is refined fairy stone.
[b]Ash[/b] is leftover burned fuel.
[b]Depleted Uranium[/b] is spent uranium from nuclear processing.
[b]Heavy Oil[/b] is high-sulfur oil used in fuel processing.
[b]Light Oil[/b] is low-sulfur oil used in fuel processing.
[b]Refined Heavy Oil[/b] is processed heavy oil.
[b]Refined Light Oil[/b] is processed light oil.
[b]Refined Uranium[/b] is uranium prepared for nuclear fuel.
[b]Solid Fuel[/b] is compressed fuel for industrial machines.
[b]Prismatic Bar[/b] is purified prismatic metal.[/spoiler]
[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Power Equipment[/b][/size][/color]
[spoiler][b]Machines that add power to the grid:[/b]
[b]Furnace[/b] produces 10 power while processing.
[b]Combustion Generator[/b] produces 20 power. It uses fuel inputs to make battery packs and add power to the grid.
[b]Electric Generator[/b] produces 30 power. It converts coal, fuel, or batteries into grid power.
[b]JojaCola Generator[/b] produces 5 power. It uses Joja Cola as fuel.
[b]Nuclear Generator[/b] produces 200 power. It uses radioactive fuel and produces depleted uranium.
[b]Solar Generator[/b] produces 10 power when it has sun.

[b]Machines that use power:[/b]
[b]Alternator E. Furnace[/b] uses 10 power. It smelts crushed metals.
[b]Auto Miner[/b] uses 20 power. It collects mining materials over a full day.
[b]Battery Charger[/b] uses 10 power. It uses grid power to make battery packs.
[b]Ceramic Kiln[/b] uses 5 power. It turns clay into bricks.
[b]Chromium Furnace[/b] uses 20 power. It smelts faster and gives extra output.
[b]Combustion Miner[/b] uses 5 power. It is a coal-fueled mining machine.
[b]Electric Furnace[/b] uses 5 power. It smelts regular and crushed ores without coal.
[b]Gem Polisher[/b] uses 20 power. It upgrades gems to iridium quality.
[b]Hay Bin[/b] uses 5 power. It turns fiber into hay.
[b]Industrial Distillery[/b] uses 5 power. It processes larger batches like an upgraded keg.
[b]Preservative Press[/b] uses 5 power. It processes larger batches like an upgraded preserves jar.
[b]Pulverizer[/b] uses 5 power. It crushes ores and minerals into pulverized materials.
[b]Rock Crusher[/b] uses 5 power. It breaks down stone, bars, and ores.
[b]Tree Cloche[/b] uses 5 power. It grows tree seeds into wood or hardwood.[/spoiler]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Water[/b][/size] [/color][size=4][b][color=#00ffff]and[/color][color=#ffff00] Power Equipment[/color][/b][/size]
[spoiler]These machines use both water and power from Utility Grid Redux.

[b]Chemical Processing Machine[/b] uses 10 water and 10 power. It refines coal into fuel, oil into refined oil, and heavy oil into solid fuel.
[b]Garden Cloche[/b] uses 5 water and 10 power. It takes 24 of the same seed and grows iridium-quality crops.
[b]Hay Rehydrator[/b] uses 1 water and 5 power. It turns hay back into fiber.
[b]Mineral Washer[/b] uses 5 water and 20 power. It cleans minerals and improves them to iridium quality.
[b]Oil Drill[/b] uses 5 water and 5 power. It produces light oil or heavy oil.
[b]Super Garden Cloche[/b] uses 100 water and 100 power. It takes 480 of the same seed and grows a large batch of iridium-quality crops.[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url] is supported. When installed, this mod adds an [b]Industrialization[/b] crafting category for its machines.

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
